title: 第六章 上门索命
novel_title: 坟头开铺，我靠守墓重整阴阳两界
content_zh:
鬼火一灭，槐荫坡像被人一口吞进了黑夜里。

    沈清萝只觉得耳边一空。

    不是安静。

    是所有鬼都不敢出声。

    那种压迫感从院门外压进来，沉甸甸盖在肩上。寻常邪祟靠近，七枚乾隆通宝最多发烫；可此刻，那串铜钱几乎要烧穿她的衣料。

    糖糕压低身体，背毛炸成一团。

    阿青贴在引魂铃上，魂体都淡了几分。

    铁柱抱着账本，默默挡到沈清萝前面。

    他小小一只，站得却很稳。

    谢无咎垂眸扫了他一眼。

    “让开。”

    铁柱没动。

    沈清萝把他往身后一拎。

    “账房别站前排，贵。”

    铁柱认真点头，退后半步。

    宋砚看着沈清萝，语气比谢无咎客气一点，但也有限。

    “沈姑娘，渊胎本属幽冥渊。你误收残魂，我们可以不追究。交出来。”

    沈清萝问：“交给你们之后呢？”

    宋砚：“带回幽冥渊。”

    “它身上的血煞契呢？”

    “幽冥渊自会处理。”

    “谁刮了它的渊印？”

    宋砚沉默一瞬：“我们会查。”

    沈清萝笑了。

    “那就是你们也不知道。”

    宋砚皱眉。

    谢无咎看着她，声音冷淡。

    “你想说什么？”

    “我想说，你们连它怎么被害都没查清，上来就抢魂。渊主办事这么省流程？”

    谢无咎向前一步。

    煞气随他一步压近，院中老槐树枝叶狂抖，贴在门楣上的镇宅符哗啦作响。

    “我不是来与你商量。”

    沈清萝手中镇煞符微微发热。

    她很清楚自己打不过。

    谢无咎这种级别的煞气，不是她一个通灵下阶守墓人能硬抗的。

    可她同样清楚，引魂铃里的小煞灵在怕。

    那孩子一样的残魂，怕灰袍邪修，怕血煞契，也怕眼前这个来势汹汹的幽冥渊主。

    沈清萝见过太多这种魂。

    活着被人推来推去，死了还被人抢来抢去。

    最后所有人都说一句：这是规矩。

    可没人问它疼不疼。

    她抬起桃木剑“挽剑”，横在身前。

    “谢渊主，你要讲归属，拿文书。你要讲规矩，我陪你去玄司。你要现在动手——”

    她把镇煞符夹在指间。

    “那就按私闯民宅算。”

    宋砚：“……”

    劫煞将沉默地看向自家渊主。

    谢无咎眼底终于有了一丝明显情绪。

    大概是被气的。

    “私闯民宅？”

    沈清萝点头。

    “还吓坏我的鬼，踩了我的地，熄了我的灯。都要赔。”

    阿青在后面小声提醒：“阿萝，差不多行了。”

    糖糕却冷笑：“本仙支持，狗来了都要收踩地费。”

    宋砚低声：“糖糕大人，渊主不是狗。”

    糖糕高傲抬头：“本仙只是打比方，狗不背锅。”

    沈清萝第一次正眼看宋砚。

    “你还挺懂礼貌。”

    宋砚：“……”

    谢无咎抬手。

    “够了。”

    黑煞从他袖中涌出，直逼沈清萝掌心引魂铃。

    他动作不快。

    甚至算得上从容。

    可沈清萝发现，自己根本躲不开。

    那不是普通煞气，而像一整片深渊压下来。
content_en:
Once the will-o'-the-wisp was extinguished, Huaiyinpo seemed to have been swallowed into the darkness.

Shen Qingluo felt her ears empty.

Not quiet.

All the ghosts dared not speak out.

That sense of oppression came in from outside the courtyard door, covering his shoulders heavily.The seven Qianlong Tongbao would be extremely hot when evil spirits were approaching. But at this moment, the string of copper coins was almost burning through the material of her clothes.

Tang Cake lowered his body and the hair on his back exploded into a ball.

Ah Qing clung to the soul-inducing bell, and his soul became a little lighter.

Tie Zhu held the account book and silently stood in front of Shen Qingluo.

He is small, but he stands very steadily.

Xie Wu Jiu lowered his eyes and glanced at him.

"Get out of the way."

The iron pillar did not move.

Shen Qingluo lifted him behind him.

"Don't stand in the front row of the accounting office. It's expensive."

Tie Zhu nodded seriously and took half a step back.

Song Yan looked at Shen Qingluo and his tone was a little more polite than Xie Wujiu's, but it was limited.

"Miss Shen, the abyssal fetus belongs to the Netherworld Abyss. You mistakenly collected the remnant soul, so we don't need to pursue it. Hand it over."

Shen Qingluo asked: "What happens after I leave it to you?"

Song Yan: "Bring it back to Netherworld Abyss."

"Where is the blood evil bond on it?"

"Netherworld Abyss will take care of it."

"Who scratched its abyss mark?"

Song Yan was silent for a moment: "We will investigate."

Shen Qingluo smiled.

"That means you don't know either."

Song Yan frowned.

Xie Wujiu looked at her with a cold voice.

"What do you want to say?"

"I want to say that you didn't even find out how it was killed, and you just snatched its soul when you came up. How can Yuanzhi save the process?"

Xie Wujiu took a step forward.

The evil spirit approached with his step, the branches and leaves of the old locust trees in the courtyard shook wildly, and the house-securing talisman affixed to the lintel of the door rattled.

"I'm not here to discuss it with you."

The Evil Suppressing Talisman in Shen Qingluo's hand was slightly warm.

She knew very well that she couldn't beat him.

Xie Wujiu's level of evil spirit was not something that a low-level psychic tombkeeper like her could resist.

But she also knew that the little evil spirit in the soul-inducing bell was afraid.

The remnant soul like that child was afraid of the evil cultivators in gray robes, the blood evil pact, and the menacing Lord of the Netherworld Abyss in front of him.

Shen Qingluo has seen too many such souls.

He was pushed around when he was alive, and he was snatched around when he was dead.

In the end, everyone said: This is the rule.

But no one asked if it hurt.

She raised her mahogany sword and held it horizontally in front of her.

"Master Xie Yuan, you have to explain your ownership and get the documents. You have to follow the rules, and I will accompany you to Xuansi. You have to take action now -"

She held the Suppression Talisman between her fingers.

"Then it will be treated as breaking into a private house."

Song Yan: "..."

Jie Sha will look at his Yuan Master silently.

Xie Wujiu finally had a hint of clear emotion in his eyes.

Probably out of anger.

"Break into a house privately?"

Shen Qingluo nodded.

"The ghost who scared me, stepped on my land, and put out my lights. I have to pay for it."

Ah Qing reminded in a low voice from behind: "A Luo, it's almost done."

But Tang Cake sneered: "I support it. Dogs will be charged for tramping on the ground when they come."

Song Yan whispered: "Master Tang Cake, Master Yuan is not a dog."

Tang Cake raised his head arrogantly: "I'm just using metaphors, dogs don't take the blame."

Shen Qingluo looked at Song Yan for the first time.

"You're quite polite."

Song Yan: "..."

Xie Wujiu raised his hand.

"That's enough."

Black evil spewed out from his sleeves, pressing into the soul-inducing bell in Shen Qingluo's palm.

He doesn't move quickly.

Even calm.

But Shen Qingluo found that she couldn't escape at all.

It was not an ordinary evil spirit, but like a whole abyss pressing down.
